Subject: Launch Update and October 8 Staging Demo

Hi Avery,

The tentative October 8 production launch will not proceed because the required security approval will not be completed before October 12 at the earliest. Nia owns the security review, and the team is prepared to address any remediation it may require. No new production date is authorized yet.

We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data, allowing us to maintain momentum while the review is completed.

Please confirm whether you would like to proceed with the October 8 staging demo.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
